editions.title: This weekend in motorsport
editions.intro: Looking ahead to the weekend of 4–5 October, we have plenty of action across several championships. Formula 1 and MotoGP both head into round 16, while NASCAR continues its season at round 31. The NHRA and World Rally Championship also have important events scheduled for the coming days.

items.headline: Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia
items.detail: Sepang International Circuit, Malaysia · Sun 4 Oct
items.body: The Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia takes place on Sun 4 Oct at 07:00 UTC. With qualifying set for 08:00 UTC on Sat 3 Oct, all eyes will be on the championship battle where Andrea Kimi Antonelli holds an 84-point lead over George Russell.
facts: Andrea Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 84 points from George Russell

items.headline: Grand Prix of Japan
items.detail: Mobility Resort Motegi, Japan · Sun 4 Oct
items.body: The Grand Prix of Japan arrives at Mobility Resort Motegi on Sun 4 Oct. Jorge Martin holds a slim two-point advantage over Marc Marquez in the championship standings.
facts: Jorge Martin leads the championship by 2 points from Marc Marquez

items.headline: South Point 400
items.detail: Las Vegas Motor Speedway · Sun 4 Oct
items.body: The South Point 400 runs at Las Vegas Motor Speedway on Sun 4 Oct from 21:30 UTC. This 400.5-mile race consists of 267 laps, with US coverage available on TV via USA and on radio through PRN.

items.body: The Midwest Nationals will be held at the World Wide Technology Raceway in Illinois on Sun 4 Oct.

items.body: Round 13 of the World Rally Championship is Rally Italia Sardegna, taking place in Alghero, Italy on Sun 4 Oct.

lastRaces.headline: Motul Petit Le Mans
lastRaces.detail: Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta · Sat 3 Oct
lastRaces.body: The Motul Petit Le Mans was held at Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta. This round took place on Saturday 3 October.

lastRaces.headline: 6 Hours of Fuji
lastRaces.body: The 6 Hours of Fuji was held at Fuji Speedway, Japan. It ran on Sunday 27 September.

lastRaces.headline: Nationals at The Rock
lastRaces.detail: Rockingham Dragway, North Carolina · Sun 27 Sep
lastRaces.body: The Nationals at The Rock took place at Rockingham Dragway in North Carolina. This event occurred on Sunday 27 September.

lastRaces.headline: Hollywood Casino 400
lastRaces.body: Kyle Larson from Hendrick Motorsports won the Hollywood Casino 400 at Kansas Speedway, with Austin Cindric for Team Penske and Denny Hamlin of Joe Gibbs Racing also on the podium. The race featured 13 lead changes among seven drivers over 267 laps.

lastRaces.headline: Baku
lastRaces.detail: Baku City Circuit, Azerbaijan · Sun 27 Sep
lastRaces.body: The Formula 2 action returned to the Baku City Circuit in Azerbaijan on Sunday 27 September for round 12. It was a busy weekend of racing on the streets of Baku.

lastRaces.headline: Azerbaijan Grand Prix
lastRaces.detail: Baku City Circuit, Azerbaijan · Sat 26 Sep
lastRaces.body: George Russell from Mercedes won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix on Saturday 26 September, with Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar of Red Bull following him to the podium. Andrea Kimi Antonelli held an 84-point lead over Russell in the championship.
facts: Andrea Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 84 points from George Russell

lastRaces.headline: Grand Prix of Austria
lastRaces.detail: Red Bull Ring - Spielberg, Austria · Sun 20 Sep
lastRaces.body: Pedro Acosta of Red Bull KTM Factory Racing won the Grand Prix of Austria on Sunday 20 September, ahead of Aprilia Racing's Jorge Martin and Marco Bezzecchi. Jorge Martin led the championship by two points from Marc Marquez.
facts: Jorge Martin leads the championship by 2 points from Marc Marquez

lastRaces.headline: Spa-Francorchamps
lastRaces.detail: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps, Belgium · Sat 19 Sep
lastRaces.body: The Clio Cup Series visited Spa-Francorchamps on Saturday 19 September for round 5. The circuit features a 7.004 km lap with 19 corners and has been racing since 1921.

lastRaces.headline: Rally Chile
lastRaces.body: Rally Chile took place in Concepcion, Chile, on Sunday 13 September for the twelfth round of the World Rally Championship.

lastRaces.headline: Madrid
lastRaces.body: The tenth round of Formula 3 was held in Madrid, Spain, on Sunday 13 September.

lastRaces.headline: Monza (double-header)
lastRaces.detail: Autodromo Nazionale Monza, Italy · Sun 6 Sep
lastRaces.body: The seventh round of the Porsche Supercup was a double-header at Autodromo Nazionale Monza in Italy on Sunday 6 September. This circuit features an 11-corner, 5.793 km lap and was first raced in 1922.

lastRaces.headline: Season Finale
lastRaces.detail: WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca · Sun 6 Sep
lastRaces.body: The IndyCar season concluded with its finale at WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca on Sunday 6 September.
